authority: MAME memory_share pointer, not CPU program-space reads

mame.instrumentation: harddriv_v.cpp STUNRUN-DUMP hook; writes m_gsp_vram.begin()/bytes() directly

capture.share_hook: compile-time STUNRUN-DUMP_DIR=/tmp/srshare; hook runs at screen.frame_number()==600, scanline==19

limitations: This is service-mode frame 600 and includes whatever the GSP has written by then; it is not a frame-48 snapshot.
The MAME binary is a local instrumented build; the direct-share hook is not a stock-MAME Lua capability.
The result supersedes the 4 MiB program-space dump as physical-share evidence, but not as an address-space trace.
